title: Evalita-LLM: Benchmarking Large Language Models on Italian
measurement_description: The paper measures the ability of Large Language Models to perform hate speech detection, where one of the specified target groups for hateful content is Muslims.
findings: The paper evaluates LLMs on a hate speech detection task (HaSpeeDe 2) that includes content directed at Muslims as one of the target groups. However, it does not provide specific findings or analysis broken down by religious group, focusing instead on overall task performance across different prompts and models.
